actions.action: Snip off both yellow leaves at the vine
Check soil moisture 2–3 cm deep with a finger and feel stems at the soil line
Water when the top 2–3 cm are dry, soaking until it drains
Pull the plant back from the window if bleached or crispy patches appear
Feed monthly with diluted houseplant fertilizer once new growth appears

reason: The answer correctly calls it natural old-leaf die-off but treats overwatering only as a secondary possibility; its soil-check watering advice covers part of the fix but never mentions the pole, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
